    def __init__(self, to, next, cap, flow, cost):
        self.to = to
        self.next = next
        self.cap = cap
        self.flow = flow
        self.cost = cost

def point(x, y):

def init(n):

    head = [-1] * (N)

def add_edge(u, v, cap, cost):

    edges[tol] = Edge(v, head[u], cap, 0, cost)
    head[u] = tol
    tol += 1
    edges[tol] = Edge(u, head[v], 0, 0, -cost)
    head[v] = tol
    tol += 1

def spfa(s, t):
    global dis, vis, pre
    for i in range(N):
        dis[i] = INF
        vis[i] = False
        pre[i] = -1
    dis[s] = 0
    vis[s] = True
    q = deque([s])
    while q:
        u = q.popleft()
        vis[u] = False
        i = head[u]
        while i != -1:
            v = edges[i].to
            if edges[i].cap > edges[i].flow and dis[v] > dis[u] + edges[i].cost:
                dis[v] = dis[u] + edges[i].cost
                pre[v] = i
                if not vis[v]:
                    vis[v] = True
                    q.append(v)
            i = edges[i].next
    return pre[t] != -1

def minCostFlow(s, t):
    global cost
    flow = 0
    cost = 0
    while spfa(s, t):
        Min = INF
        i = pre[t]
        while i != -1:
            if Min > edges[i].cap - edges[i].flow:
                Min = edges[i].cap - edges[i].flow
            i = pre[edges[i ^ 1].to]
        i = pre[t]
        while i != -1:
            edges[i].flow += Min
            edges[i ^ 1].flow -= Min
            cost += edges[i].cost * Min
            i = pre[edges[i ^ 1].to]
        flow += Min
    return flow
